title: Bee Removal in Lawrence, Long Island
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Lawrence, Long Island. Licensed nest treatment and removal. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: The Best Pest Control NYC provides professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee nest removal throughout Lawrence, Long Island — protecting homes and businesses from stinging insect nests in wall voids, soffits, attics, eaves, and structural wood. Our licensed technicians treat and remove nests from properties near the waterfront estates along Causeway and throughout Lawrence's residential neighborhoods, with clear pricing confirmed on the phone before any work begins.
whyUs: As Lawrence's trusted pest control experts, we understand the unique challenges of bee infestations in this upscale waterfront community. Our team provides same-day or next-day service, uses eco-friendly methods that protect your property and landscape, and offers guaranteed results with full licensing and insurance for your peace of mind.
localContext: Lawrence's proximity to the water and abundance of mature trees, gardens, and wooden structures make it particularly attractive to wasps, hornets, and carpenter bees seeking nesting sites. Paper wasp nests appear under eaves and in attic vents, yellow jackets colonize wall voids and ground burrows, and carpenter bees tunnel into the exposed wood of decks, pergolas, and trim. From the historic homes near Lawrence Village to modern properties along the peninsula, we've treated hundreds of nests in soffits, chimneys, sheds, and structural cavities throughout the area.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and bee removal cost in Lawrence?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest from my Lawrence property?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day or next-day service in Lawrence for most situations. Nests near entrances, patios, or high-traffic areas with active stinging activity receive priority scheduling to ensure the safety of your family and neighbors.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Lawrence?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: What types of stinging insects are common in Lawrence?
faqs.answer: Lawrence properties commonly experience paper wasps, yellow jackets, bald-faced hornets, and carpenter bees due to the area's lush landscaping, waterfront location, and wooden structures. Carpenter bees tunnel into decks, pergolas, and siding; yellow jackets and paper wasps build nests in wall voids, soffits, eaves, and attics; ground-nesting yellow jackets colonize lawn burrows and landscape beds throughout the neighborhood.
